description: [Data utilities] Check whether an email address looks real and deliverable before sign-up, outreach or invoicing. Use when you need a quick check with no side effects. Price: $0.0015 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/email-verify

email.description: Email address, or up to 25 comma-separated

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: email_verify
title: Email Address Check (syntax, MX, disposable, SPF/DMARC) ($0.0015)
